slot: Payments: desktop apps / licence keys / digital goods

pick.name: Polar
pick.what: Licence keys with activation limits, expiry, usage quotas
pick.why: Licence keys with activation limits and usage quotas; open source
pick.free_limits: Starter 5% + 50c (no monthly fee); Pro $20/mo 3.8% + 40c; Growth $100/mo 3.6% + 35c; Scale $400/mo 3.4% + 30c; +1.5% international cards; Early Members (orgs before 2026-05-27) keep 4% + 40c; payouts incur Stripe Connect fees

alts.name: Dodo Payments
alts.what: One-time or subscription sales with licence keys (activation limits, client-side activate/validate)
alts.why: Same MoR as your SaaS = one KYC, one payout, cheaper than Polar for one-time sales (no +0.5%)
alts.free_limits: One-time: 4% + 40c (+1.5% non-US); licence keys included; activate/validate callable from client apps without API secret

alts.name: Gumroad
alts.free_limits: 10% + 50c direct; 30% via Discover; MoR for sales tax since 2025-01-01

candidates.name: Paddle
candidates.verdict: No built-in licence keys in Paddle Billing (not re-verified)

candidates.name: Keygen
candidates.verdict: Licensing server to pair with any MoR (not checked)

candidates.name: Google Play Billing
candidates.verdict: Mandatory for in-app digital goods on Android: 10%+5% billing fee subs in EEA/UK/US/AU/JP (new structure), 15% elsewhere; India alt-billing 4% lower

decision: Keep licence sales on the same MoR as SaaS so there is one tax and payout stream. Polar's licence-key API is the most flexible; Dodo includes keys that client apps can validate without a secret; Gumroad adds discovery at 10% + 50c. In-app purchases on mobile must use Apple or Google billing regardless.
details: No free option: every MoR/licensing store takes a per-sale fee; a self-hosted licence server (e.g. Keygen CE) still needs a paid payment processor. Candidates list must show Polar as PICK and Dodo as Alt.

verify.note: Polar licence keys (activation limits, expiry, usage) are a real built-in benefit; fees as verified above. Candidates table still says 'Dodo: PICK' (stale) - fix candidates verdicts to match.
